bias.zh: 偏空 · 反弹至 5 日均线

read.en: The Nasdaq ADS rose 4.0% on Oct 23 to $137.02, trading between $135.21 and $138.51, with no 100-day average yet (75 sessions). It is below the falling 5-day ($138.9), 10-day ($144.4) and 30-day ($170.9) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Sep 28 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 7 ($155.94), and RSI is 35.
read.zh: 纳斯达克 ADS 10月23日上涨 4.0%，收于 $137.02，盘中区间 $135.21–138.51；上市仅 75 个交易日，尚无 100 日均线。股价位于下行的 5 日（$138.9）、10 日（$144.4）和 30 日均线（$170.9）下方。MACD 自 9月28日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月7日起看空（$155.94），RSI 为 35。

read.en: The rebound reclaimed $133.8 (Aug 7 low) and stalled at $138.5, inside the next resistance. Resistance is $137.1–138.9, then $144.4 (10-day) and $146 (Oct 15 and 21 highs). Support is $133.8–135.2 (Aug 7 low, Oct 23 low), then $130.8 (Oct 22 low) and $124.8 (52-week low). A close above $138.9 would target $144–146; a close below $130.8 would open $124.8.

r.en: Oct 15 and Oct 20 lows ($137.1–137.8); 5-day average $138.9; Oct 23 high $138.5

bias.zh: 偏空 · 反弹站上 125 万韩元

read.en: SK hynix closed at ₩1,277,000 in Seoul on Oct 23, up from ₩1,223,000, after a ₩1,171,000–1,284,000 range that set a new October low. It is above the falling 5-day (₩1,258,800) and below the falling 10-day (₩1,296,700), 30-day (₩1,619,033) and 100-day (₩1,868,960) and the rising 200-day (₩1,477,425). MACD has been below its signal and zero since Oct 5; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Sep 28 (₩1,350,110), and RSI is 33.

The rebound reclaimed ₩1.25 million (Jul 29 low, 5-day average). Resistance is ₩1.28–1.30 million (Oct 23 high, 10-day), then ₩1.33 million (Oct 15–16 and Oct 21 highs) and ₩1.35 million (SAR). Support is ₩1.25 million, then ₩1,171,000 (Oct 23 low) and ₩1,060,000 (Mar 18 high). A close above ₩1.30 million would target ₩1.33 million; below ₩1,171,000, ₩1,060,000.
read.zh: 反弹收复 125 万韩元（7月29日低点、5 日均线）。阻力为 128–130 万韩元（10月23日高点、10 日均线），其次 133 万韩元（10月15–16日和10月21日高点）和 135 万韩元（SAR）。支撑为 125 万韩元，其次 ₩1,171,000（10月23日低点）和 ₩1,060,000（3月18日高点）。若收盘站上 130 万韩元，下一目标看 133 万韩元；若跌破 ₩1,171,000，则看 ₩1,060,000。
